questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
If you like to be evaluated for class participation, you should do it.
If you like to attend mandatory classes almost every day, you should do it.
If you like to be taught by practitioners instead of intellectuals, you should do it.
